units.counts: Dictionary elements or module communities, counted separately at each layer; these are not unique biological programmes across layers.
units.pooled_rates: Summed feature counts divided by summed dictionary or catalogue-alive counts, as named.
units.unweighted_layer_summaries: Arithmetic mean and range across 26 layer values, with each layer weighted equally.
units.floors: Saved random-set null means/values among alive features; all-feature values rescale by n_alive/n_features. Pooled floors weight alive-set nulls by alive counts.
units.reconstruction: Fresh variance_explained_reextracted and dead_val_reextracted, not training-file metrics. VE is not pooled across layer variances.
units.module_coverage: Assigned features divided by dictionary total or catalogue-alive count as named.
units.independence: No term test or model inference was rerun. Counts/IDs/summary fields and module memberships were independently recounted; floor means were checked against saved seed values.
